latestVersion.changelog:
Compressor AI — initial release!

- Quickly compress and export videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) with simple instructions.
- Automatic backend connection and authentication on first use; free 7-day trial token included.
- Supports uploading, editing, and exporting 1080p MP4s via cloud GPU processing (30–90 seconds typical for clips).
- Credit usage, upload status, and export handled via clear text prompts; virtually no manual configuration required.
- Robust error handling and guidance for common issues (token, credits, file size, etc.).
- Designed for creators needing fast, high-quality, smaller video files.
